back2basics.text: Climate finance refers to funds provided by developed countries to support developing countries in mitigating and adapting to climate change. Adaptation finance specifically helps vulnerable communities adjust to the adverse effects of climate change, such as extreme weather and rising sea levels. It is important that adaptation finance is predictable, adequate, and grant-based to avoid increasing debt burdens on developing countries.

2026-11-27-pm-091b0e6ae6.deck: At COP31 in November 2026, India welcomed a $50 million pledge to the Adaptation Fund but emphasized that this amount is inadequate given the scale of adaptation needs in developing countries. India stressed the importance of timely, accessible, and primarily grant-based adaptation finance and highlighted ongoing efforts to push for stronger global climate finance commitments.

back2basics.text: Crop insurance schemes like the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provide financial protection to farmers against crop losses due to natural calamities such as drought, floods, and pests. Farmers pay a premium, and in case of crop failure, they receive compensation to mitigate income loss and sustain agricultural activities. This mechanism reduces the risk burden on farmers and supports agricultural stability.

2026-11-27-pm-0f07d13cbc.deck: Kalaburagi district administration has requested over ₹375 crore in interim compensation under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana for crop losses caused by deficient rainfall in the 2026-27 kharif season. This case highlights the functioning and importance of crop insurance schemes in supporting farmers facing climatic risks.

back2basics.text: The Constitution of India is the supreme law that lays down the framework defining fundamental political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and duties of citizens. It aims to secure justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity for all citizens, thereby promoting social and economic justice.

back2basics.text: Electoral rolls are official lists of eligible voters in a constituency, maintained to ensure free and fair elections. Voter registration requires accurate personal details, including age and relationship data, to prevent fraud. Periodic revisions like the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) are conducted to update and correct the rolls, removing duplicates and errors to uphold election integrity.

2026-11-27-pm-55a48db9b9.deck: An analysis of Karnataka's final electoral rolls revealed over 17,000 entries where parents are recorded as younger than or the same age as their children, highlighting persistent discrepancies despite revision efforts. This issue raises concerns about the accuracy of voter data, which is crucial for election integrity and governance.

back2basics.concept: Export Controls and Technology Supply Chains
back2basics.text: Export controls are government-imposed restrictions on the shipment of certain technologies to other countries, often for national security reasons. They can affect global supply chains by limiting access to critical components like AI chips. Understanding these controls is important to grasp how geopolitics influences technology availability and digital infrastructure development.

2026-11-27-pm-6aafb09c24.deck: Nvidia has stopped shipping AI servers containing its chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia due to tightened U.S. export controls. This affects regional data centers and highlights the impact of technology export restrictions on global AI supply chains, relevant for India's digital economy and geopolitical strategy.

back2basics.text: The southwest monsoon is the main rainy season in Kerala, supplying most of its annual rainfall. El Niño is a climatic phenomenon characterized by warming of the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, which can influence monsoon patterns in India. 2026-11-27-pm-9b6241791f.deck: Kerala has experienced below normal monsoon rainfall in only 5 of the 15 El Niño years between 1951 and 2022, indicating that El Niño does not always cause drought in the state. body.label: Cross-border travel facilitation
body.text: Indian citizens can travel to Nepal without a visa if they have a valid passport, simplifying cross-border movement via this train.

sections.heading: Why does the Ayodhya-Janakpur train service matter for India-Nepal relations?

body.label: Train composition
body.text: The Saryu Kamala Express uses modern 17-coach LHB rakes, including eight air-conditioned coaches, seven sleeper-class coaches, and special luggage and power cars.

body.label: Ticket fares
body.text: Ticket prices range from ₹365 for sleeper class to ₹1,360 for AC 2 Tier, with other options like AC 3 Economy and AC 3 Tier available.

body.label: Booking options
body.text: Passengers can reserve tickets online through IRCTC or at railway reservation counters.
